Cc: accounts-payable@cascade-supplies.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Update: Cascade Supplies — change of legal entity and bank setup

Hi Logan,

Quick note from Cascade — we closed a small acquisition and as part of that we are consolidating two subsidiaries. Effective 2027-04-15 our invoices should be billed to Cascade Supplies Ltd. (new consolidated EIN) and we will be moving payments to a new primary bank account.

I attached the KYC packet and a signed EIN amendment for your records (Cascade_KYC_packet_2027-04-02.pdf, Cascade_EIN_update_signed.pdf). Can you confirm next steps on your side to get the vendor record switched over and avoid payment disruption for the month end? We have a PO outstanding for April services and invoice 67851 is due 04/20.

Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Operations
Cascade Supplies Ltd.
elena.morales@cascade-supplies.com
+1 (415) 555-2490

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the docs. I reviewed the KYC packet and the signed EIN amendment; those should be sufficient to start a vendor record update.

Next steps from Redwood Procurement/Finance:
- Procurement will create a supplemental vendor change request and route to AP for bank validation.
- Finance (Karthik) will run the EIN reconciliation and flag any tax implications for treasury.
- You'll get a confirmation email once the vendor record is updated and a short test ACH file is run (low-dollar) to validate routing prior to the 04/20 invoice payment.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in to kick off the internal workflow. Elena, can you confirm whether the new bank should replace the existing payee record entirely, or whether Cascade wants the new consolidated record added as a second payee and the old account retired after the trial payment? Also, please confirm the portal owner who should receive invoice notifications and who will sign future PO amendments.

Logan
Logan Wright
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the packet. Quick summary after initial reconciliation: the EIN in the signed amendment matches the IRS lookup for the merged entity, so no W-9 reissue required immediately; however, tax should receive the scanned docs for record keeping. The new routing number provided is ACH-capable and domestic.

Action items I queued:
- Finance will run a $1.00 ACH test to the new routing on 2027-04-06, low-dollar debit/credit pair to validate.
- I've created the vendor change in our vendor management system (Proc-4921) with effective date 2027-04-15.
- Marked invoice 67851 as "hold pending validation" to avoid inadvertent payment to an old account.

Elena — once the test clears on 04/06 I'll send a confirmation and we can remove the hold so the 04/20 invoice pays as scheduled. If you want us to retire the old payee record after two successful cycles, confirm and we'll set that automation.

-Karthik
